projects.title: Selected Work
projects.description: Interactive interfaces engineered for motion, clarity, and product-grade detail.

cyberverse-landing.title: CyberVerse Landing Page
cyberverse-landing.description: Immersive landing page for an NFT marketplace with 3D showcase scenes.
cyberverse-landing.brief: A Web3 startup needed a launch page that felt as futuristic as the product itself.
challenges: Rendering NFT 3D previews without hurting first-load performance
Wallet-connect flow that stays intuitive for non-crypto-native visitors

architecture.frontend: React + Three.js hero scene, Tailwind design system
architecture.apis: Ethers.js wallet connect, IPFS metadata fetch
architecture.animations: Framer Motion scroll reveals, R3F model rotation

aura-ai-dashboard.title: Aura AI Dashboard
aura-ai-dashboard.description: Analytics dashboard for an AI SaaS product with live usage charts.
aura-ai-dashboard.brief: Aura needed a dashboard that made complex model usage data easy to scan at a glance.
challenges: Keeping chart re-renders smooth on live-updating datasets
Type-safe API layer shared between dashboard and admin panel

architecture.backend: tRPC API over a Postgres analytics store
architecture.apis: REST ingestion endpoint, WebSocket for live metrics

nexus-dex.title: Nexus Decentralized Exchange
nexus-dex.description: Trading terminal for a decentralized exchange with live order books.
nexus-dex.brief: A DeFi protocol needed a trading terminal that felt as fast as a centralized exchange.
challenges: Streaming order-book updates without UI jank
Gas-efficient transaction batching for swap confirmations

architecture.frontend: React + Tailwind, Framer Motion for order-book animation
architecture.apis: Ethers.js contract calls, WebSocket price feed
